name: Environmentally Preferable Purchasing FY15 - Construction
description: This dataset lists City Government construction contracts subject to Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) rules during fiscal year 2015. Each of the 30 sampled rows records the awarding agency, a description of the contract, the registration date, the EPP product type involved, whether the products meet EPP minimum standards (Yes or No), and the contract value in dollars. Agencies include DPR, DHS, NYPD, DCAS, DSNY, and DDC, and product types range from Energy Star products and architectural coatings to carpet, roof coating, and faucets. Contract values span roughly $119,000 to $142.6 million. The data can be used to track compliance with green purchasing standards, compare sustainable procurement spending across agencies, identify which product categories meet or fall short of EPP requirements, and support reporting or analysis of environmentally preferable purchasing practices.
